title: Signal: Shell command executed through Open3 from a string in ruby — review required
scope: Single-line match on string-form Open3 execution in ruby.
limitations: Lexical: matches capture3 calls whose first argument is a variable or interpolated string.

examples.line: # audit: stdout, stderr, status = Open3.capture3("convert #{user_file} out.png") present
# verified: stdout, stderr, status = Open3.capture3("convert", user_file, "out.png")

fpNotes: Constant commands built from literals are the accepted false positives.
